description: Use this when the user asks about air permits, EPA nonattainment, or on-site gas turbine / generator permitting near a data center site, for example "air permits for gas turbines near Midland, TX" or "is this site in an ozone nonattainment area?". Returns the EPA Green Book designations (nonattainment or maintenance, pollutant, classification, area) for the county the point is in, US-wide, plus TCEQ-listed gas-turbine air permits of 20 MW or more (issued and pending) within radius_km, Texas only: company, permit number, status, date, distance, MW, turbine model, NOx limit, source URL. Dated snapshot with as_of and cite_as. Reciprocating engines, permits by rule and non-Texas filings are not covered and the answer says so. Do NOT use for moratoriums or zoning (use get_permitting_intel). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 31.97

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. -102.08

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Radius for nearby permit filings in km, 1-300 (default 100)

site.description: DC Hub market slug instead of coordinates, as rank_markets lists it, e.g. "midland-tx" (Midland–Odessa), "dallas". Resolved to that market's PUBLISHED CENTROID through the DCPI market row; the answer carries resolved_from.
